burro · run your coding agent's tests on your own server

Usage: burro <command> [flags]

Set up (once)
  host add <name> <user@host>   add a server
  init                          set up this project and the agent rules

Run tests
  run [pipeline]                sync the code and start a run, returns at once
  wait                          wait for the run, then print a short summary
  status                        how the run is going
  failures                      what failed and where
  log --step <name>             clean log of one step, --grep to search it
  cancel                        stop the run

Server
  exec -- <command>             run one command on the server
  sync                          copy the code to the server without a run
  doctor                        check that the server is ready
  host ls                       list your servers
  clean                         remove a run's docker leftovers and secrets

Typical loop
  burro run           start
  burro wait          Ctrl+C is safe, the run keeps going
  burro log --step e2e --grep login

Exit codes  0 passed · 1 tests failed · 2 server problem · 3 still running
            4 bad config or flags · 5 another run is active

burro <command> --help   details and an example
burro help config        burro.toml fields and test reporters
